gaps.desktop: The loser shows the repeat only as a ~9px grey circular-arrow badge clipped onto the top-right edge of the ~24px circled calendar icon beside '26 Aug', with no rule text at all, so you cannot tell that it repeats at a glance or how it repeats. The badge collides with the icon's ring and looks like a rendering glitch. The winner puts a ~14px repeat glyph and the words 'Every Monday' in ~14px mid-grey (#6b6b6b) as their own item, ~24px right of the bold 'Mon, Aug 26'. The fix is to drop the overlapping badge and add a readable repeat-icon-plus-rule label next to the date, at the date's text size.

why: The winner states both the due date (with weekday) and the repeat rule in plain text; the loser hides repetition in a tiny overlapping badge and never shows the rule.
